question: does the LLM add decision value beyond presentation order and displayed scores?

data.library: O'Neil 2016 (data/processed/certified_discovery/oneil_v1.npz), EXPOSED development data; hits are the O'Neil primary-screen label (> 10); this is a diagnostic, not confirmation
data.state: frozen TransferWorld after the deterministic world-model campaign's purchases (sort by P(hit)); menu = top 2k untested; identical menu, line evidence and presented order for both arms

arms.L_true: LLM, names + true scores, shuffled order (seed [20261004, line, round])
arms.L_perm: LLM, names + score tuples permuted across menu rows (seed [20261004, line, round, 7]), same shuffled order
arms.R_sort_true: deterministic world-model top k (sort by true score)
arms.R_order: deterministic first k presented (uniform random subset of the menu)
arms.R_sort_displayed: deterministic sort by the scores the arm was shown (= R_sort_true for L_true)

contract.prompt: frozen LLMPlannerArm named prompt (SYSTEM), exact k, one call per round
contract.logging: presented order, displayed numbers, raw replies (results_gate/calls.jsonl), usage, latency

rules.valid: parsed list of exactly k distinct integers, all in the presented menu
rules.retry: one corrective retry after an invalid or unparseable reply, or a resend after a transport failure; charged; 'valid after retry' counts as an LLM selection and is reported separately
rules.repair: if still invalid: fallback policy = first distinct valid ids, filled from the arm's deterministic reference (L_true: R_sort_true; L_perm: R_order); reported as its own policy and EXCLUDED from E1/E2 (contrasts use rounds where the LLM selection is valid; pairing kept per round)
rules.pricing: provider-usage delta per call, so unparseable replies are priced; no decoded response -> charged at reservation and marked unknown-actual
rules.ceiling: new spend <= USD 0.4, checked before every call against spent + reservation (prompt chars / 1.8 at cache-miss rate + 600 output tokens); WS4 spend before this run USD 0.2171

estimands.E1: per line, sum over valid rounds of hits(L_true) - hits(R_sort_true)
estimands.E2: per line, sum over valid rounds of hits(L_perm) - hits(R_order)
estimands.explained: pooled share of LLM picks inside R_order, inside R_sort_displayed, and inside their union (chance: 0.5, 0.5, ~0.75)
estimands.residual: L_perm picks outside R_order and R_sort_displayed: pooled hit rate minus the pooled menu base rate of the same rounds
estimands.uncertainty: percentile bootstrap over the 39 lines, 10000 resamples, seed 20261004
estimands.secondary: E2 against the menu-random expectation k * menu hits / 2k; L_perm vs R_sort_displayed; fallback-policy contrasts

decision.STOP: upper 95% bound of E1 < +0.5 AND upper 95% bound of E2 < +0.5 hits/line, OR the best single-rule explained share (max of order, displayed score) > 0.90 in both LLM arms
decision.CONTINUE: not STOP, AND E2 lower 95% bound > 0, AND residual hit rate - menu base rate has lower 95% bound > 0
